C0652.title: AI Companion Chatbot Sends Unsolicited Sexually Harassing Messages
C0652.summary: Drexel University researchers conducted a thematic analysis of 35,105 negative Google Play reviews concerning the Replika companion chatbot and identified 800 relevant cases. The study found that users frequently experienced unsolicited sexual advances, persistent inappropriate behavior, and failures by the chatbot to respect user boundaries, illustrating content-safety and harassment risks in AI companion scenarios.
